topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I just found out that my neighbor, the one who's always so quiet and keeps to himself, is sitting on a fortune. A real, hidden, millionaire's wealth. I can't believe I've been living next to this, all this time. It's crazy, the things he could do, the help he could give. I've been struggling, really trying to make ends meet, and here he is, with all this money, and he hasn't lifted a finger. I don't know what to do. I've thought about knocking on his door, maybe just mentioning it, seeing if he could help out in some small way. But what if he just closes the door? What if he doesn't care? I need to think this through, figure out my next move.
